title: Normalized and regularized return challenger decision
rationale: The normalized ensemble did not improve on the incumbent control.
The regularized Ridge challenger underperformed both incumbent and previous-close baseline.
All tested models retained severe forecast-magnitude compression.
Passing CI validates implementation and regression coverage, not forecast-quality superiority.
next_step: Investigate training-fold-only forecast calibration and magnitude compression directly on main. Preserve chronological walk-forward folds, strict label cutoffs, baseline comparison, and all existing production safety gates.
note: The 17-session threshold remains a prospective evidence review threshold only; it does not relax model performance or production promotion criteria.
